title: Ethics and Social Responsibility in AI-Assisted Interviewing: An LLM-in-the-Loop Study of AI-Generated Follow-Up Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of participants' reflections during a Wizard-of-Oz simulated interview study, identifying concerns about the AI generating culturally inappropriate language or discriminatory remarks (e.g., offensive comments about an interviewee's accent).

Qualitative thematic analysis of interviewers' feedback, identifying 'technology-based participation inequality' where AI systems implicitly discriminate against or disadvantage individuals with lower technological proficiency and digital literacy.
